criteria.id: dispatch recommendation ranks eligible members by capacity, WIP, role, skills, and blocked status
policy-approved automatic dispatch assigns exclusive work to one member and writes an audit event
a second member cannot claim the same exclusive WorkItem while its exclusive lease is held
a shared read lease allows a second participant when the task permits pair or review work
rebalance releases leases and assignments when work is blocked or cancelled
a short-lived lease can be acquired, renewed, expired, and released with owner, reason, and linked task
exclusive write leases block conflicting editors; project conflicts lists those overlaps
WorkItem detail shows agent feedback, open questions, decisions, blockers, missing evidence, and next actions linked to the producing run and skill versions
accepting feedback can update the WorkItem; rejected feedback remains auditable and does not update it
customers cannot dispatch work or decide agent feedback
